_meta.note: Data-completeness nudge loop — the missing class of CTAs that drive the user to RAISE data completeness & accuracy (connect a device, answer questions, take a measurement), distinct from the behaviour-change nudges in adherence.json. Each fires when a degradation state (degradation-model.json) leaves a pillar cohort-filled / low-coverage / stale; ranks by ΔAccuracy-per-effort; escalates cadence as data ages past its Freshness SLA; and stops (no spam) per the engagement state machine. Illustrative; re-verify (README §5.6).
_meta.principle: lead with value (the gap that most raises Accuracy for least effort) · escalate with persistence, never guilt · cap & stop (StopOutreach after repeated ignores) · honour quiet hours / channel firewall (Doc 11 §9).
_meta.ranking: ΔAccuracy-per-effort: rank candidate completeness CTAs by expected Accuracy gain ÷ user effort (the 'next-best-input' / information-gain proxy that P1–P5 static priority lacks). The input that most sharpens the score for least effort is offered first.

classes.DEVICE: connect / pair / wear a device so a whole channel of metrics starts flowing
classes.INTAKE: answer a small high-yield set of intake / lifestyle questions
classes.MEAS: take or order a specific measurement / lab to replace a cohort estimate

escalation.model: Offer at a base cadence. On dismiss → back off (decreasing cadence). As the underlying data AGES past its Freshness-SLA stale-after, BUMP the CTA's ranking priority and cadence (a 95-day-old ApoB outranks a 30-day-old one). Cap frequency (no spam). After N ignores → StopOutreach (engagement state machine Dormant→ReEngage→StopOutreach).
escalation.freshness_sla: tied to the per-metric fresh-within / stale-after SLA (coverage-audit F8 / wearable-metrics sampling). Staleness, not just absence, raises a completeness nudge.
escalation.continuity: the loop runs continuously: every score render re-evaluates cohort-fill % and re-ranks completeness CTAs, so as the user closes one gap the next-best one surfaces — progressive data collection over time.
